newsitem.title: USA: US cash crude grades ease on turnarounds, foreigns.
newsitem.headline: US cash crude grades ease on turnarounds, foreigns.

text.p: U.S. cash crudes returned to weaker prices Thursday afternoon after flirting with higher prices brought on by a short-lived NYMEX rally.
News of Mexican port closures due to high winds and waves prompted the early afternoon uptick, which has since faded.
Cash dealers said the grade market steadied from earlier losses, but maintained a soft profile.

Sweet and sour grades were hit hard by cheap competition from foreign crudes. Refinery turnaround slates for January prompted more selling in the sours, where West Texas Sour/Midland was dealt at a low of $1.55 under WTI/Cushing.
